name: url-shortener-srvc
description: AI-assisted URL shortener — Firebase Cloud Functions + Firestore + React. Emulator-first, runnable end-to-end with no cloud credentials.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm run build:functions && npm run build:web
scripts.e2e:app: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,hosting
scripts.e2e:install: npm --prefix e2e install && npm --prefix e2e exec -- playwright install chromium
scripts.predev: npm run build:functions && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n functions,emulators,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm --prefix functions run build:watch" "npm run emulators" "npm --prefix web run dev"
